ruleDefinitions.name: SCM Database Handle Failure
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects non-system users failing to get a handle of the SCM database. Note: Unmapped fields: ObjectType, ObjectName, AccessMask, SubjectLogonId

sequences.query: (event_id = 4656 AND ObjectType = "SC\_MANAGER\ OBJECT" AND ObjectName = "ServicesActive" AND AccessMask = "0xf003f") AND  NOT (SubjectLogonId = "0x3e4")
